thread:
Emma (CS): Hey team — MarinerAI is launching a regional marketing push tomorrow 06:00 UTC. They asked for a temporary rate-limit increase for APAC + Brazil, plus a peering allowlist for three CIDR blocks. They also want region pinning to ap-southeast-1 and sa-east-1 for latency. Can ops/infra help? cc @Aisha (AM) for renewals/comms.

Tyler (Support): Copy — do we have org id and exact CIDRs? I can queue the rlift but need details to avoid a mistake.

Emma (CS): Org ID: org_09M2z. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25, 192.0.2.0/28. Request: 3x token throughput for apac & br for 48h, auto-revoke after 48h unless CS extends.

Sanjay (NetEng): Ok — we can do pinning + allowlist. Quick questions: will traffic hit our public frontdoor or via peering? If peering, we'll update peering ACL; if public, update global allowlist. Also will they require header passthrough?

Emma (CS): They confirmed GCP peering into our ingress (via peering). So peering ACL is required. Also they asked headers x-rr-client and x-request-id preserved for tracing. Renewal risk: campaign could double monthly burn — Aisha to follow up on commercial.

Aisha (AM): I'll schedule a renewal sync and flag SalesOps. If spend > 2x baseline we should discuss a committed plan or promo.

Tyler (Support): Internal ticket created: #CS-4521. Command to apply (ops CLI):

```
/rlift allowlist create --org org_09M2z --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --cidr 198.51.100.128/25 --cidr 192.0.2.0/28 --regions ap-southeast-1,sa-east-1 --throughput-multiplier 3 --duration 48h --autorevoke
```

Emma (CS): Please add a note to the ticket: "customer-side headers to preserve: x-rr-client, x-request-id" — they rely on these for tracing across retries.

Sanjay (NetEng): Added to the ticket and set route priority to pinned for those regions. We'll apply peering ACL entries and set the temp route policy. Will post when changes are live.

infra-bot: SRV change queued: #CS-4521 -> pending change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Approve with :thumbsup:.

Aisha (AM): Approved. :thumbsup:.

Tyler (Support): Deployed allowlist + regional pinning. Verified connectivity from 203.0.113.5 and 198.51.100.200. Monitoring for 30m, watching token rate and error spikes.

Emma (CS): Thanks all — capturing customer feedback: MarinerAI requested a Console "burst" product toggle for easier self-serve temporary throughput in future. Filing FR in product backlog and adding to ticket.

Sanjay (NetEng): Noted. Leaving monitoring on for 24h, will auto-revoke at 48h unless CS extends via ticket.

Tyler (Support): Closing loop with customer: forwarded ticket link and activation confirmation.
